Guide.title: How It Works
Guide.intro: Booked already? On-site, it's just four steps.
Guide.step1Desc: Before you go, open your booking QR under 'My bookings' or your profile. The signal on-site can be spotty, so taking a screenshot is even safer.
step1Tips: We recommend arriving up to 10 minutes before your slot.
The QR works only for the person who made the booking.
You can change or cancel from your profile until the start time.
Guide.step2Desc: Hold the QR to the entrance reader and your booking is verified automatically. Take a moment to check the sport, time, and court shown on screen.
step2Tips: If it won't scan, raise your screen brightness and try again.
Companions enter together within your booked party size.
Entry may be limited after your start time, so please be on time.
Guide.step3Desc: Once verified, head in and use your booked time slot and court. Use only your assigned court or area, and bring the basics like indoor shoes and sportswear.
step3Tips: Treat the facilities and equipment with care, and report any damage to staff right away.
No outside food or smoking inside the facility.
Stick to your time slot so you don't run into other users' bookings.
Guide.step4Desc: When your time is up, tidy up your space and check out to finish. Please clear the court on time for the next guest.
step4Tips: Return equipment to its place and take your trash with you.
Leave on time out of courtesy for the next user.
Ask at the front desk about any lost items.
